targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_seconds - estimated_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS hours FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND estimated_duration_seconds > 0 AND actual_duration_seconds > 0

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (actual_duration_seconds - estimated_duration_seconds)) / 3600.0, 2) AS hours FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND estimated_duration_seconds > 0 AND actual_duration_seconds > 0
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom()
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom()

SELECT COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material, ROUND(AVG(ABS(actual_duration_seconds - estimated_duration_seconds)) / 3600.0, 2) AS avg_diff_h FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND estimated_duration_seconds > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT estimated_duration_seconds / 3600.0 AS est_hours, actual_duration_seconds / 3600.0 AS act_hours, COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND estimated_duration_seconds > 0 AND actual_duration_seconds > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom()

SELECT COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material, ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_seconds - estimated_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS avg_diff_hours FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND estimated_duration_seconds > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2

SELECT DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_seconds - estimated_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS avg_diff_h FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND estimated_duration_seconds > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS material, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT filename, status, COALESCE(filament_type, '—') AS material, ROUND(actual_duration_seconds / 60.0) AS duration_min, start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth' AS started FROM print_jobs WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 20
